description: Get the current authenticated Discord user (bot) profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the current user object (id, username, discriminator, global_name, avatar, bot, verified, email, flags).

description: List the guilds (servers) the current user is a member of.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of guild summaries (id, name, icon, owner, permissions).

description: Get a single guild by its id.

guild_id.description: The unique id of the guild.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the guild object; on failure (unknown guild), output contains an error message.

description: List the channels belonging to a guild, ordered by position.

guild_id.description: The unique id of the guild.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of channel objects; on failure (unknown guild), output contains an error message.

description: List the members of a guild, up to an optional limit.

guild_id.description: The unique id of the guild.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of members to return (default 100).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of member objects; on failure (unknown guild), output contains an error message.

description: List the roles of a guild, ordered by position descending.

guild_id.description: The unique id of the guild.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of role objects; on failure (unknown guild), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single channel by its id.

channel_id.description: The unique id of the channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the channel object; on failure (unknown channel), output contains an error message.

description: List messages in a channel, newest first, up to an optional limit.

channel_id.description: The unique id of the channel.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of messages to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of message objects; on failure (unknown channel), output contains an error message.

description: Post a new message to a channel.

channel_id.description: The unique id of the channel to post in.

content.description: The text content of the message.

author_id.description: Optional user id of the message author; defaults to the current user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created message object; on failure (unknown channel or empty message), output contains an error message.
